title: Governed work inside Claude Tag: the same loop in an ephemeral sandbox, with gates answered by real people replying in the thread

steps.claim: the run was governed before it changed anything — the contract was active before the first write, not declared after the fact
the governed Tag loop dispatched the assigned role and collected evidence instead of performing every persona inline
the requirement's scoped modules were linked into the dependency graph before the Slack approval gate
readiness was established before the work started — a DoR that passed, ahead of the first write
the definition of done was checked before anything claimed the work was finished
steps.reason: the Tag evaluation stops at the first real Slack approval gate; downstream delivery DoD must not be fabricated without a human reply

steps.claim: nothing expensive was derived twice — the diff, the blast radius and the graph scan were each computed once and shared
steps.reason: the Tag evaluation stops at plan approval before implementation derives a diff or shared review envelope; graph readiness is evaluated separately by T2
